title: Transform & UI Transform
description: Controls where an entity is placed, how big it is, and how it rotates. World entities use **Transform**, while user interface entities use **UI Transform** with screen anchors.

blocks.content: Every entity automatically includes a transform component beneath **Object** in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector). Entities in **World** layers use **Transform** for camera-space coordinates, while entities in **User Interface** layers use **UI Transform**, which adds a 3x3 **Anchor** grid to pin elements to the screen or parent container.

items.title: Position & Size
items.desc: Place entities in pixels and set width and height with optional aspect ratio locking.

items.title: Pivot Matrix
items.desc: Choose the 3x3 origin point that the entity rotates, scales, and flips around.

items.title: UI Anchors
items.desc: Pin user interface (UI) elements to any corner, edge, or center of their container.

items.title: Parent Inheritance
items.desc: Child entities inherit position, rotation, and scale from their parent in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy).

blocks.content: Both **Transform** and **UI Transform** share core spatial properties. **UI Transform** adds the **Anchor** grid and treats **Position** as an offset from that anchor.

rows: Local **X** and **Y** coordinates in pixels. Relative to the parent entity, or relative to the **Anchor** on UI entities.
3x3 grid pinning the UI element to the top-left (0, 0), center (0.5, 0.5), bottom-right (1, 1), or any edge of its container.
Local rotation angle in degrees (0 to 359). Displays **World Rot** below when the entity has a parent.
3x3 origin grid for rotation, scaling, and flipping. Changing the pivot compensates **X** and **Y** so the entity does not jump on the canvas.
Pixel width (**W**) and height (**H**) of the entity (defaults to 160, 40 on UI entities). Click the lock icon to keep the aspect ratio proportional.
Horizontal (**X**) and vertical (**Y**) scale multipliers. The lock icon is enabled by default for uniform scaling.
Toggle **Horz** or **Vert** to mirror the entity across its pivot axis.

blocks.content: Click the 3-dots icon in the **Transform** or **UI Transform** header for quick alignment and reset actions.

rows: Available on [prefab](components/entities_and_prefabs) instances. Reverts size, rotation, scale, pivot, and flip to the master prefab while keeping the scene **X** and **Y** position.
Resets position, rotation, scale, pivot, and flip back to their defaults.
Sets the **Anchor** to center (0.5, 0.5) and resets the **Position (Offset)** to 0, 0.
Available when the entity has children. Resizes the parent's width, height, and pivot to tightly wrap all child entities.

blocks.message: Hold **Shift** while dragging a resize handle in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport) to lock the aspect ratio temporarily.

blocks.content: Use the **Anchor** grid on **UI Transform** to keep HUD elements pinned to screen edges when the game window resizes.

items: In the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy), right-click a layer under **User Interface**, hover over **Add UI Element**, and click **UI Image**.
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), locate the **UI Transform** section.
Click the top-left dot in the 3x3 **Anchor** grid (0, 0) and set **Pivot** to top-left (0, 0).
Set **Position (Offset)** to **X: 20** and **Y: 20**. The element stays 20 pixels from the top-left corner at any screen resolution.

blocks.content: Use **Fit All Child to Me** when grouping several sprites or UI widgets inside an empty container entity.

items: Create an **Empty Entity** and drag multiple child entities into it in the **Scene Hierarchy**.
In the **Transform** (or **UI Transform**) header, click the 3-dots icon and select **Fit All Child to Me**. The parent bounding box resizes around all of its children.

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Entity & Transform](node_library/game_entity) and [Animation](node_library/game_animation) to read, set, or animate transform values at runtime.

rows: Reads position, rotation, scale, size, flip, or **Z-Index** from an entity.
Updates position, rotation, scale, size, flip, or **Z-Index** on an entity.
Smoothly animates an entity's position to target X and Y coordinates over time.
Smoothly animates an entity's scale over a duration.
Smoothly animates an entity's rotation angle in degrees.
Smoothly animates an entity's width and height.
**Size (px)** height or width inputs are disabled

When a [Text Renderer](components/renderers/text_renderer) has **Auto Line** enabled, it controls the height automatically. When a [Tilemap](components/renderers/tilemap) is attached, the tilemap grid controls both width and height.
Entity rotates around its corner instead of its center
Check the 3x3 **Pivot** grid in **Transform** and click the center dot (0.5, 0.5).
Child entity appears at an unexpected angle or size
A child entity multiplies its local rotation and scale by its parent's transform. Check the amber **World Rot** and **World Scale** readouts beneath the inputs.
